description: Run PMD static code analysis on source files. Detects code quality issues, bugs, and style violations.

excludes.description: File patterns to exclude from analysis

minimum_priority.description: Minimum priority to report (1=highest, 5=lowest). Default: all

path.description: Path to source file or directory to analyze

rulesets.description: Rulesets to apply (e.g., ["rulesets/java/quickstart.xml"]). Defaults to quickstart.

name: pmd_check
